mentions.name: AI Robo Advisor
mentions.description: This proof-of-concept AI-powered robo advisor runs a user survey to understand investment goals, creates a personalized strategy, and builds a portfolio aligned with that strategy. It analyzes the portfolio using financial APIs, tax diversification, and client alignment, then provides a detailed portfolio analysis. The goal is to see how far an AI agent can go in replicating and automating the work of a hedge fund; it is for educational purposes only, not real investment.
mentions.audience: Educational purposes only, not for real investment
mentions.source_excerpt:
